name: Kane County, IL
findings: Kane County has 1,262 nonprofit organizations. 564 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 454 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Kane County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few health care organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 8 health care organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 21 would.
